notes.title: Upcoming Horror Game Demo
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JC-V24r5XwI

The Full Version Will Be On Steam

Game Link-https://flgaming.itch.io/the-front-door-package-demo


While on Your Way to Bed After a Long Day of Work
At 1 AM in You Receive a Package at Your Door Step
And The Night Unravels From There And Your Slow Descend
into Madness Begins

"Front Door Package " is a First - Person Psychological Horror Thriller.
The Game Takes Place After You Receive the Package Stumbling Through Scary
Dimensions Looking for a Way Home

Average time to Complete the DEMO is : 90 minutes

In The Front Door Package The Main Character Has a Slow Decent Into
Madness-Solving Puzzles,  Traveling Through Dimensions,
Finding Weapons, Fighting Enemies
After Receiving the Package

notes.title: The CrashCourse Challenge Release
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=12d5lxl4D3Q;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]In The CrashCourse Challenge You Speed Your Way down Abusive 30,20,10 Second Race Tracks With Destructible Super cars In Hopes of Getting Past Obstacles to Make it to the Finish Line Before Your times Up


Features




Addictive Gameplay

Changeable Vehicle Behavior types -Racing, Drifting, Aggressive, Off-road Etc,

50+ Obstacle Courses Levels

15+ Destructible Cars

Realistic Car Driving System

Realistic Car Physics

Challenging Obstacles

Cinematic Camera Modes

Fps And TPS Povs

Very Challenging Levels

Are You Up For The Challenge ?



A Game of lols, Angry ,and Rage Quits Where Only the Best Will Survive.
Where failing will make you Ask Yourself How.....

Do it to Prove how Gangsta You Are
